zh.title: A2RT — 面向智能体与环境的实时业务信息交互协议
zh.description: A2RT 提供可配置的多轨信息通道和统一时间契约。了解谁发送谁负责、Profile 异常策略，以及 Canvas Realtime 本地验证实例。
zh.hero_description: 声音、画面与操作，共享时间刻度，各有更新节拍。A2RT 为智能体与环境提供可配置的多轨信息通道，约定交换什么、何时交付，以及何时可以消费。
zh.hero_note: 统一时间 · 谁发送谁负责 · Profile 定义契约
zh.console_label: 根时钟与独立信息同步组的配置示意
zh.console_caption: 取自规范配置示例 · 数值用于说明关系，不代表性能或时延保证
zh.strip_two: 独立同步组 · 自定义轨道
zh.protocol_intro: A2RT 是面向智能体与环境的实时业务信息交互协议。时间、容量与同步关系共同约定，让接收方获得满足消费条件的信息。

principles.title: 同一刻度，不同节拍
principles.body: 根时钟提供时间与容量基准，子时钟组织更新节拍。所有窗口边界精确落在整数根刻度，子时钟不创造额外容量。

principles.title: 按组组织，独立交付
principles.body: 同组内容使用共同窗口，各接收端按 Profile 判断完整性。多个组可以共享时钟，仍然独立推进。

principles.title: 谁发送，谁负责
principles.body: 双方发送端组织、对齐并校验信息，承担发送侧恢复；接收端验收后消费。模型专注理解与业务输出，无需拼包或修复传输。

zh.architecture_title:
清楚的边界，
可扩展的环境。
zh.architecture_intro: Core、Profile、Binding 划分规范职责；发送端、接收端、适配器与运行时落实这些职责。同一进程可以承担多项工作，职责仍然清晰。
zh.architecture_link: 阅读 Core 与 Profile 职责
zh.architecture_note: 当前为架构设计草案。Canvas Realtime 已有本地 mock、配置与 Schema；尚未发布覆盖全部约束的通用线协议和运行时。

layers.name: A2RT Core
layers.subtitle: 承载、时间与通用约束
layers.body: 管理时钟树、同步组、轨道引用与交付状态，约束每轨每周期单帧、共享容量和各接收端队列。

layers.name: Profile
layers.subtitle: 定义内容与交互规则
layers.body: 声明内容语义、消费条件、同步完整性、播放和执行规则；选择异常丢弃、通知、恢复或终止的策略。

layers.name: Binding
layers.subtitle: 落实节拍与资源预算
layers.body: 落实序列化、连接与来源绑定、传输重组、发送调度和队列约束，复用底层传输能力；传输成功不代表业务完成。

zh.example_intro: 查看规范中的时钟、同步组与轨道配置片段。它们解释架构关系，不是已发布的新线协议消息格式。
zh.fixture: 架构草案 · 配置示意

example_notes.title: 时间与容量一起约定
example_notes.body: root 的频率、标准帧字节数和每刻容量共同构成调度基准，须匹配实际生产、传输与消费能力。

example_notes.title: 每条轨道，一个位置
example_notes.body: (epoch, sync_group_id, frame_seq, track_id) 定位数据帧。分片、重传、多来源或双向发布都不增加名额。

example_notes.title: 配置冻结，历史可解释
example_notes.body: 时钟、分组、策略、限额和格式在 epoch 内冻结。变更需重新协商，旧数据保留原来的时间与配置解释。

zh.faq_title:
实现之前，
先对齐这些约定。

faq.question: 现在有哪些可以检查的实现？
faq.answer: Canvas Realtime 提供 0.3.0-draft Profile、会话配置、内容 Schema 和本地 mock 的验证文档，包含 10Hz 交互与真实 L16 音频流。它尚未接入真实模型，也不代表覆盖全部约束的通用 SDK、线协议或生产运行时。

faq.question: A2RT 固定只有六条轨道吗？
faq.answer: 轨道可以按需注册。Canvas 的配置包含六条领域轨道，另外必须配置唯一的 system 输入轨道。角色与方向只定义在轨道上。

faq.question: Core 是否要求错误消息或逐帧 ACK？
faq.answer: 不要求。Profile 可以选择直接丢弃、通过自定义轨道或独立通道通知，并决定恢复或终止。system 是必选输入轨道，但不是强制错误通道；异常策略仍须遵守帧数、容量和真实交付状态约束。

faq.question: 同步组会让所有内容互相等待吗？
faq.answer: Profile 定义各接收端需要哪些内容、何时完整及如何处理超时。输入和输出同组不形成循环等待；多个组即使共享时钟也独立交付。

faq.question: system 通知是否必须独立成组？
faq.answer: 不必须。Profile 可以让唯一 system 输入轨道与媒体同组，也可以独立配置。需要及时通知时推荐独立组；实际中断和清理不等待通知配齐。

faq.question: 根时钟频率就是性能保证吗？
faq.answer: 频率与容量表达调度约定。实际时延还取决于配置、突发负载和运行时是否落实预算；仅通过时间换算与预算算式不能证明运行时性能。

zh.closing_title: 为下一种实时环境，定义连接。
zh.closing_body: 从时间、同步与内容契约出发，参与 A2RT 架构的讨论与实现。

en.title: A2RT — Agent-to-Real-Time Protocol
en.description: A2RT is a real-time business-information protocol for agents and environments, with configurable tracks, shared time, sender responsibilities, and Profile-defined delivery.
en.hero_description: Audio, visuals, and actions share time, with their own rhythms. A2RT gives agents and environments configurable tracks and a contract for what to exchange, when to deliver, and when to consume.
en.hero_note: Shared time · Sender responsibility · Profile contracts
en.console_label: Configuration illustration of a root clock and independent synchronization groups
en.console_caption: From the draft configuration · Illustrative values, not latency or performance guarantees
en.protocol_title: Give real-time information a common ground.
en.protocol_intro: A2RT is a real-time business-information protocol for agents and environments. Time, capacity, and synchronization contracts make information ready for its receiver to consume.

principles.title: Shared time, different rhythms
principles.body: A root clock defines time and capacity. Child clocks organize updates. Window boundaries map exactly to integer root ticks; child clocks add no capacity.

principles.title: Grouped, independently delivered
principles.body: Tracks in a group share windows. Each receiver applies its Profile’s completeness rules. Groups may share a clock and still advance independently.

principles.title: The sender prepares the information
principles.body: Both senders organize, align, and validate information and own send-side recovery. Receivers admit usable content. Models reason and produce business output, without packet repair.

en.architecture_title:
Clear boundaries.
Room for your world.
en.architecture_intro: Core, Profile, and Binding define normative responsibilities. Senders, receivers, adapters, and runtimes implement them. One process may serve several roles without merging their responsibilities.
en.architecture_note: Architecture design draft. Canvas Realtime has a local mock, configuration, and schemas. A general wire release and runtime covering all constraints are not yet available.

layers.name: A2RT Core
layers.subtitle: Carriage, time, and invariants
layers.body: Clock trees, synchronization groups, track references, and delivery states. Enforce one data frame per track per period, shared budgets, and receiver queues.

layers.name: Profile
layers.subtitle: Content and interaction contracts
layers.body: Define content semantics, consumption conditions, completeness, presentation, and execution. Choose whether to discard, notify, recover, or terminate after errors.

layers.name: Binding
layers.subtitle: Make timing and budgets operational
layers.body: Map serialization, connections, source binding, reassembly, pacing, and queues to transport capabilities. Transport success does not prove business completion.

en.example_intro: Explore clock, group, and track excerpts from the draft. They illustrate architecture relationships, not a released new wire message format.

example_notes.title: Time and capacity together
example_notes.body: Root frequency, standard-frame bytes, and units per tick define a scheduling contract that must match production, transport, and consumption capacity.

example_notes.title: One position per track
example_notes.body: (epoch, sync_group_id, frame_seq, track_id) identifies a data frame. Fragmentation, retries, multiple sources, or directions do not add slots.

example_notes.title: Frozen configuration, stable history
example_notes.body: Clocks, groups, policies, limits, and formats are frozen within an epoch. Changes require negotiation; old data keeps its original interpretation.

faq.question: What implementation can I inspect today?
faq.answer: Canvas Realtime documents a 0.3.0-draft Profile, session configuration, content schemas, and a local mock with 10 Hz interaction and actual L16 audio. It has no real model integration and is not a general SDK, wire release, or production runtime covering all constraints.

faq.question: Does A2RT have exactly six tracks?
faq.answer: Tracks are registered as needed. Canvas uses six domain tracks plus the mandatory, unique system input track. Role and direction are defined only on tracks.

faq.question: Does Core require error messages or per-frame ACKs?
faq.answer: No. A Profile may silently discard, notify through a custom track or separate channel, and choose recovery or termination. The required system input is not a mandatory error channel. Frame limits, budgets, and truthful delivery state still apply.

faq.question: Does synchronization make everything wait?
faq.answer: Each receiver’s Profile defines required content, completeness, and timeout behavior. Input and output in one group do not create circular waiting. Separate groups remain independent even when sharing a clock.

faq.question: Must system notifications have their own group?
faq.answer: No. A Profile may place the unique system input track with media or in a separate group. A separate group is recommended for timely notifications; actual interruption and cleanup do not wait for delivery.

faq.question: Does root frequency guarantee performance?
faq.answer: Frequency and capacity express a scheduling contract. Actual latency depends on configuration, bursts, and runtime enforcement. Valid clock arithmetic and budget totals alone do not validate runtime performance.

en.closing_body: Start with time, synchronization, and content contracts. Help shape the A2RT architecture.
en.root_capacity: 1,024 B / standard unit · 1 unit / root tick
en.one_frame: Each track / period: at most 1 data frame

groups.description: A 100 ms window groups four example tracks. Each receiver checks its own delivery conditions. The bidirectional state track still has only one publishing slot per period.
The tactile group advances independently in 10 ms windows. It shares root capacity with other groups; its Profile defines completeness and partial delivery.
This example places the unique system input track in a separate group. Other Profiles may share a group; actual interruption and cleanup do not wait for notification delivery.
